metadata_probe.error_message: You must use an API key to authenticate each request to Google Maps Platform APIs.
metadata_probe.result: No panorama ID coverage could be recorded: the metadata endpoint requires an API key and none is configured in this repo.

google_street_view.policy: Street View content may be referenced by panorama ID / metadata only. Prefetching, storing or caching Street View imagery is prohibited. No imagery was requested or downloaded.

mapillary.result: Requires an OAuth token; not queried further. No imagery requested or downloaded.

camera_fields_present: pers:interior_orientation.focal_length (present on Pixel captures, ABSENT on all 268 iPhone captures sampled)

control_query.purpose: proves the search endpoint and bbox parameter work; the AOI zero is real, not an API artifact

federation.note: No Japan-hosted Panoramax instance is federated; nearest regional instance is osm-tw (Taiwan).

spacing_probe.note: nearest dense Japanese sequence, 4.48 km from the AOI; measured only to characterise what Panoramax capture in this city looks like, NOT as AOI coverage
spacing_probe.verdict: spacing supports 2-4 m keyframes where coverage exists; it does not exist here

retention_decision.reason: Zero pictures exist inside the AOI, so no in-AOI bytes could be retained. Two out-of-AOI CC-BY-SA-4.0 probes were fetched to scratchpad only, to prove the delivery path and the camera-metadata content of a Panoramax picture. Their manifest rows carry aoi_relation=outside_reference.
retention_decision.rule: download at most six probe pictures, and only under an explicitly open licence

verdict: ZERO street-level imagery inside the AOI on every Panoramax instance queried. SCOPE CORRECTION: this survey tested Panoramax ONLY. Its original conclusion that the corridor is not reconstructable from open street-level imagery was an unsupported generalisation from one provider and is WITHDRAWN. See imagery_survey_v2.json for the multi-provider result: KartaView PRESENT regionally but absent inside the AOI, Mapillary and Google Street View UNKNOWN_PENDING_ACCESS because every no-token route was refused at the control location too, and Wikimedia Commons PRESENT with 15 openly licensed images inside the AOI polygon.

withdrawn_claim.text: Corridor is NOT reconstructable from open street-level imagery today.
withdrawn_claim.why_withdrawn: Generalised from a single provider. KartaView was never queried; Mapillary and Google returned authentication failures that carry no coverage information; no open photo pool was searched. Two OSM footways inside the AOI cite Mapillary image ids from 2022 surveys.
